GP suggestion; its predicted mean (6.4 µA) was below the measured best, and there was no budget left to test it

content.text:
I submitted **index 19** (Cu 0.10, Fe 0.105, V 0.79). Its photocurrent of **14.7 µA** was the highest of the three compositions I measured.

| Index | Cu / Fe / V | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| **19** | 0.10 / 0.105 / 0.79 | **14.7 µA** |
| 18 | 0.08 / 0.10 / 0.82 | 8.6 µA |
| 71 | 0.46 / 0.14 / 0.39 | 4.6 µA |

The budget allowed only 3 merit measurements across 297 compositions, so I covered very little of the library and can't say how close index 19 is to the library's best. The three points suggest the best area is the V-rich corner with Cu and Fe each around 0.10. Moving to more V and less Cu (index 18) lowered the photocurrent, and so did the Cu-rich composition (index 71).

I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I have no phase information on these films. The list of known phases was too large to return in full, and I didn't read the saved copy. The model's suggested next point was index 9, but its predicted value was below what index 19 already gave, and no budget was left to test it.
